==About==

A {{i|Shroom Patty}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Shroom Patty gains different [[Gluttony]] values depending on whether you use matching {{i|Any Mushroom}}s. '''NOTE:''' Remember to Boil your Mushrooms to reduce {{i|'Shroom Poisoning}}.
